METALWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Surface Finishing Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Surface Finishing Processes.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Finishing Processes.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Finishing Processes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Finishing Processes.

2. When learning Centre La, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Centre La.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Centre La.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Centre La.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Centre La.

3. When learning Assembly Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawings.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawings.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawings.

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

7. When learning Project 1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 1.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project 1.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 1.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 1.

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

9. When learning Gas Welding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Gas Welding.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Gas Welding.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Gas Welding.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Gas Welding.

10. When learning Metalwork related businesses, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork related businesses.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork related businesses.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork related businesses.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork related businesses.

11. When learning Forging, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Forging.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Forging.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Forging.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Forging.

12. When learning Project 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Project 2.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 2.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 2.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 2.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Heat treatment of steel and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Centre La and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Project 1 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Assembly Drawings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
